findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

During the inspection several cans were observed with significant dents. The PIC was shown and removed the cans for credit. Ensure that all cans are checked as they are stored or during receiving to ensure that possible Botulism infections are prevented.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
2-102.11: Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16.  

The dish machine is not functioning correctly at the time of this inspection. A follow up is being scheduled for two weeks to ensure that repairs are completed.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-703.11: After cleaning, FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be SANITIZED in: (A) manual hot water operations. (B) mechanical hot water operations. (C) Chemical manual or mechanical operations. Contact times shall be consistent with those on EPA-registered label use  standard contact time 30 seconds. 

The temperature based sanitizing rinse in the dish machine was never observed to reach critical temperature (160F). Numerous attempts were made using both inspector and facility measuring devices and ranges were observed between 124F-151F. A service call has been placed for the machine during this inspection. The three part sink will be set up for sanitizing as a temporary measure to allow for continued service.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

Multiple employees observed to use a paper towel to turn off the faucet and then use the same paper towel to dry their hands. Education conducted. PIC instructed to review proper hand washing and ensure that good practices are enforced.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) Observed the meat slicer to have rust on the slicer blade, as well as food debris. Ensure that the blade is repaired or replaced to provide a smooth, easily cleanable surface. 2) Observed a scale in the kitchen to have rust build up as well. Ensure that the scale is either painted or replaced to provide a smooth, easily cleanable surface. 
750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
1) Observed single service trays in the area by the three compartment sink to be being stored unprotected and food contact surface up. 2) Also, there is single service being stored in the dish area in a location that can be easily splashed with sanitizer water. Ensure that single service items are stored in manners that prevent potentials for cross contamination. The single service trays were discarded by an employee, voluntarily, and the other boxes were moved. 
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed the hand sink to have a supply of paper towels, but they were not easily accessible. Kitchen manager states that there was a new brand of paper towels being used for the dispenser and it was much more difficult to get the paper towels to dispense properly. Ensure that if using a hand towel dispenser that the manufacturer recommended product is being used. Paper towels were removed from the dispenser for easier access, to promote proper hand washing. 
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed the primary hand sink in the kitchen to be without caulking. Ensure that hand sinks are caulked to the wall to provide a smooth, easily cleanable surface. 
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed a tupperware container of white granules stored on the spice shelf that was not labeled with the common name of the product. Label all powders and granules removed from their original containers with the common name of the product.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The ceiling tiles in kitchen are acoustic, perforated-style. 
750-1210(b) Walls and ceilings in walk-in refrigeration units, food preparation areas, equipment washing areas, and toilet rooms shall be smooth, light-cored, non-absorbant, and easily cleanable. Concrete or pumice block in these locations shall be finished and sealed to provide a cleanable surface.
Replace perforated tiles with smooth tiles upon next remodeling of building.
**NOTE** - Kitchen staff reports that Administration has made plans to replace perforated tiles with smooth tiles sometime this year.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed that the edge of the countertop in the dish room has peeled off, exposing the particle board underneath.  
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.
Repair the countertop so as to be smooth and washable.
**Repeat Violation**
